A '''battle''' between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] naval forces occurred in the ice rings of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mugaar/Legends|Mugaar]] during the last stages of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The battle resulted in the destruction of a Republic fleet by a Sith task force.
Imperial ships had earlier lured a Republic border patrol, commanded by a powerful [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], into the orbital ice rings of the planet Mugaar. Communications were jammed and the Sith called for the help of the elite [[Empire's Fury]] squadron, which quickly destroyed the Republic fleet.
